dataTypes.data: Weight, body fat percentage, height, body measurements, goals, imported body-composition results, medication logs and training pain/safety feedback and associated sample/source metadata. Health information supplied to the coach or included in submitted feedback can also leave the device.
thirdPartyUse: First-party APIs hosted on Vercel; Neon stores account-owned product records.
OpenAI receives minimized authorized coach context through the first-party chat adapter.
Sentry receives submitted bug-report text or screenshots that may contain health information; automatic errors apply the error redactor. Health values are not approved analytics properties.

dataTypes.data: Step counts from Apple Health; activity level and engine-led training plans, sessions and completed sets.
thirdPartyUse: First-party APIs hosted on Vercel; Neon stores account-owned product records.
OpenAI receives authorized coach context through the first-party adapter; the deterministic engine owns prescriptions.

dataTypes.data: Training enrollment safety confirmation includes an aggregate attestation of no pregnancy/postpartum, eating-disorder risk or medical restriction. Disclosed conservatively as sensitive information even though the native API sends a combined safetyConfirmed boolean, not a condition-by-condition history.
thirdPartyUse: First-party training APIs hosted on Vercel and Neon retain the account-owned enrollment setup. The safety attestation is not an approved analytics property.

dataTypes.data: Account/profile display name, including Sign in with Apple when provided; name attached to submitted bug reports.
thirdPartyUse: Jovie Better Auth handles sign-in; Neon stores the profile through first-party APIs.
Sentry receives the name with explicitly submitted feedback.

dataTypes.data: Account email, including Apple private relay addresses; email attached to submitted bug reports.
thirdPartyUse: Jovie Better Auth handles sign-in; Neon stores account contact information.
Sentry receives the email with explicitly submitted feedback.

dataTypes.data: Uploaded progress photos and optional screenshots attached to submitted bug reports; photo date/orientation and record associations. No blanket collection of the photo library.
thirdPartyUse: Cloudflare R2 stores synced photos through first-party upload URLs; Neon stores record associations.
Sentry receives screenshots when the user submits a report with the attachment selected.

dataTypes.data: Jovie subject/account identifier, profile IDs and RevenueCat app user ID used for account ownership and entitlement reconciliation.
thirdPartyUse: Jovie Better Auth, first-party APIs/Neon and RevenueCat use account IDs for authentication, sync and subscriptions.
AnalyticsService sends no app-supplied account identity to Statsig; ErrorTrackingService redacts account identity on automatic error events.

dataTypes.data: Statsig SDK-generated stable installation identifier; device/source identifiers carried with synced HealthKit samples. Do not equate an anonymous SDK identifier with de-identified data.
thirdPartyUse: Statsig uses its stable ID for feature assignment, exposures and product analytics even with userID nil.
First-party APIs/Neon store health sample source/device metadata. Review bundled diagnostic and subscription SDK metadata with the archive.

dataTypes.data: Subscription purchases, restores, entitlement status and subscription phase transitions; no payment card or bank details.
thirdPartyUse: Apple StoreKit and RevenueCat process subscriptions and entitlements.
Statsig receives allowlisted purchase/restore markers and fixed subscription-phase enums, without transaction receipts or account IDs.

dataTypes.data: Allowlisted app launches, screen/flow actions, onboarding and purchase/restore markers, plus SDK feature-gate exposures and SDK-supplied interaction metadata. No numeric health values, free text, photo contents or app-supplied identity in app event properties.
thirdPartyUse: Statsig evaluates gates, records exposures and analyzes app events. The enum allowlist applies to app event payloads, not all SDK metadata.
Sentry breadcrumbs may record technical screen/operation context for troubleshooting.

dataTypes.data: Crash reports and captured application errors; automatic events apply the error redactor, disable default PII and clear event.user.
thirdPartyUse: Sentry processes crash/error reports. Linkage is conservatively Yes because clearing account fields alone does not prove SDK/device de-identification.

dataTypes.data: Sampled traces and technical performance measurements when SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE is enabled; disclose for the supported release configuration.
thirdPartyUse: Sentry processes enabled performance traces. A zero sample rate in one environment does not justify omitting a configurable release path.

dataTypes.data: App version/build, OS/device context, technical operation tags, redacted breadcrumbs, SDK initialization/network diagnostics and retained service security logs (including IP addresses when retained). No IP-based location inference is asserted.
thirdPartyUse: Sentry processes diagnostic events; Statsig SDK diagnostics support gate delivery and analytics.
First-party hosting/auth processors may retain security and service logs.

dataTypes.data: User-submitted bug-report message, associated name/email and optional screenshot. Disclosed without relying on Apple's optional support-form exception.
thirdPartyUse: Sentry receives user-initiated feedback through SentryFeedback, separately from automatic error-event redaction.

dataTypes.data: Saved metric notes, coach messages and voice transcripts; response text sent for requested voice playback. Raw microphone audio is not sent by the native first-party voice API.
thirdPartyUse: First-party APIs hosted on Vercel; Neon stores account-owned product records.
OpenAI processes coach messages/context through the first-party model adapter.
Configured ElevenLabs or Fish Audio speech adapter receives response text only for requested playback; submitted support text is sent to Sentry.

dataTypes.data: Date of birth (including optional Apple Health import), gender, profile preferences and consent timestamps. These are account profile fields; no inference of immutable aesthetic preferences is authorized.
thirdPartyUse: First-party APIs hosted on Vercel; Neon stores account-owned product records.

NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.text: Speech recognition turns your voice into text for your coach.

NSFaceIDUsageDescription.text: LogYourBody uses Face ID to secure your personal health data and progress photos.

NSCameraUsageDescription.text: LogYourBody uses the camera to capture progress photos for tracking your fitness journey.

NSSiriUsageDescription.text: LogYourBody uses Siri to log and read your body metrics when you ask.
